item.title: 15-year-old charged over Nottingham school stabbing
item.description: A 15-year-old has been charged following a stabbing at a Nottingham school. item.title: Eight-pupil village school could close in August 2026
item.description: Nottinghamshire County Council is being asked to approve the closure of a small village primary school near Newark following a consultation into its future. item.description: Police discovered a cannabis grow and made three arrests after reports a group were breaking into a Nottingham home. Officers attended Yatesbury Crescent, Bilborough, at 6am on Sunday 1 March and detained two suspects found inside the house.
